options.text: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which makes the leaf green and helps the cell make food by photosynthesis.
The cell membrane contains chlorophyll, which makes the leaf green and helps the cell make food.
Chloroplasts can make food by photosynthesis even without chlorophyll.
Every plastid in every part of the spinach plant carries out photosynthesis.

stem:
Navya studies a spinach leaf cell under a microscope. The leaf looks green and can make food in sunlight.

Which explanation is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Chloroplasts hold chlorophyll; chlorophyll gives green colour and enables photosynthesis. The membrane does not, and not every plastid photosynthesises.
